publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: USB enumeration is a protocol gate
record.method: Host enumeration and native stock-family traces
record.observation: A later native MUSB trial stays host-enumerated through stock IOUSBDeviceFamily and passes the stock usbmux v2 handshake with three reads, three writes and zero mux I/O errors. The earlier enumeration record remains a retained failure.
record.limits: Pairing, ideviceinfo, syslog, AFC and repeated replug acceptance remain pending. Whole usbmon completeness is false. Finite cleanup returns BUSY (-2), retains prerequisites until reset and is not claimed as successful teardown.
